svg.title: MC Salon headless setup: products live in Shopify, each gets its own Buy Button code, the code is saved on the matching Webflow CMS item, and each product page renders its own product while checkout runs through Shopify.
svg.text: Webflow on the front end, Shopify on the back end
The code is saved on the item
Each item renders its own product
Managed from Shopify and the Shopify app
FREE GIFT WITH EVERY CURBSIDE ORDER
Checkout and orders run through Shopify
